parties.respondent: Competition Commission Of India And Anr.

summary: Statutory monopoly exemption from Competition Act; Article 39(b) constitutional mandate overrides anti-competition norms; Coal Mines (Nationalization) Act, 1973-created monopoly not subject to abuse-of-dominance proceedings; policy-driven pricing/distribution immune from Sections 3/4 scrutiny; CCI findings set aside as jurisdictionally unsustainable.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; CCI order and Tribunal judgment set aside; Competition Act held inapplicable to statutory coal monopoly under constitutional mandate of Article 39(b).
